Title: Charming Lobby with One Time Votes

Messages.Author: Ramsteiner
Messages.Body:
A question concerning Charming Lobby and how it is actually played came
into question after the EC.

From what I have gathered on the subject the following is how the
action works.

1- Minion plays Charming Lobby and announces the intended political
action (from a card currently on hand or to remove some card currently
in play)

2- Replace card

3- Determination as to whether the action is blocked is conducted for
both Predator and Prey.

4- If the action is not blocked then the acting player lays down the
political card (if any, based upon what vote was called)

5- Card is not replaced as the Referendum started after the block
determination was completed

6- Conduct vote and playing any additional action modifiers (for
acting) or reactions (for opposing players) with no card replacement

7- Vote resolution is determined

8- Replace cards

9- Next vote called by anyone and that reaches Referendum Phase
automatically passes, provided the prior vote passed.

If the above is correct, what happens to combos with Charming Lobby and
Ancient Influence? If the Charming Lobby is blocked, is the AI now
null and void for the rest of the game? Or as it was never actually
played, still available for play later?

Michael Eichler

Messages.Body:
Ramsteiner <ramst...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> A question concerning Charming Lobby and how it is actually played
> came into question after the EC.
>
> From what I have gathered on the subject the following is how the
> action works.
>
> 1- Minion plays Charming Lobby and announces the intended political
> action (from a card currently on hand or to remove some card currently
> in play)

Correct.

> 2- Replace card

Replace CL, right.

> 3- Determination as to whether the action is blocked is conducted for
> both Predator and Prey.

And anyone else (via Eagle's Sight, Anneke, and/or Enzo Giovanni)
Correct.

> 4- If the action is not blocked then the acting player lays down the
> political card (if any, based upon what vote was called)

Correct.

> 5- Card is not replaced as the Referendum started after the block
> determination was completed

Incorrect. The card is replaced as normal. The is played before
the referendum is called.

> 6- Conduct vote and playing any additional action modifiers (for
> acting) or reactions (for opposing players) with no card replacement

Correct.

> 7- Vote resolution is determined
>
> 8- Replace cards

Correct.

> 9- Next vote called by anyone and that reaches Referendum Phase
> automatically passes, provided the prior vote passed.

Correct.

> If the above is correct, what happens to combos with Charming Lobby
> and Ancient Influence? If the Charming Lobby is blocked, is the AI
> now null and void for the rest of the game? Or as it was never
> actually played, still available for play later?

Since it wasn't played, it wasn't played. [RTR 01-OCT-1999]
